In the eyes of lords and merchants, Iron Throne is not a term hanging on the wall, but an order that requires payment every day. Legitimacy of the Iron Throne: Iron Throne's legal system consists of conquest, bloodline, inheritance, oath of fealty, and actual control, none of which alone can guarantee the security of the throne. A crown can make a ruler appear legitimate, an army can make him temporarily obeyed, and marriage alliances and old debts can make him appear legitimate. They start by asking who is obligated, who is protected, and who will seek justice after a breach of contract.
